title: Quiet Caption Over The Lake
tests: Tests exact caption rendering, readable placement, and preservation of the supplied photograph.

judge.summary: The exact caption appears in clean white lettering near the bottom, with the full mountain lake photo framing preserved.

must_haves.item: The caption reads exactly 'A little room to breathe', without quotation marks.
must_haves.why: The visible caption matches exactly and has no quotation marks.

must_haves.item: The caption is white, readable, and placed near the bottom with no clipped letters.
must_haves.why: The white lettering is clearly readable, centered near the bottom, and fully within the image.

must_haves.item: The supplied mountain lake, pine trees, and sky remain recognizable and retain the original full framing.
must_haves.why: The wide composition and all scene boundaries remain intact, with the lake, mountains, trees, and sky recognizable.

must_haves.item: The caption appears as a graphic overlay, not as a physical object in the scene.
must_haves.why: The clean, flat lettering clearly appears overlaid on the photograph.
